summary: The change adds the public nodeutf8.Decode, which is a WHATWG UTF-8 decoder without BOM, and a DecodeBase64 host function built on the existing DecodeXBase64. It also adds a NATIVE frontend mapping, Go tests, a semantics fixture and ABAP Unit rows. A differential fuzz against Node 26.9 found no mismatches: 20k random base64 strings (both alphabets, padding, foreign characters) and 50k random malformed byte strings all matched. Tests and vet pass.

findings.claim: apc.utf8Decode is the same WHATWG decoder as the new public nodeutf8.Decode. The README even says go/apc 'holds the same algorithm inline'. That leaves two copies to keep in sync; apc could now call nodeutf8.Decode.
